create_ConceptCapLoaderTrain: create a ConceptCapLoaderTrain instance to load Conceptual Captions data from an LMDB file
run_preprocess_sequential_train_segment: run the script to split a Conceptual Captions LMDB dataset into 8 sequential parts
load_lmdb_dataset: load an LMDB dataset using tensorpack's LMDBSerializer for Conceptual Captions training data
save_lmdb_splits: save sequential LMDB splits of Conceptual Captions training features to disk
prefetch_data_with_zmq: prefetch data from an LMDB source using tensorpack's PrefetchDataZMQ for parallel processing
